title: Research: exact three-coordinate temporal schedule on original k8 word
body:
## Result

Adds a source-pinned exact joint temporal schedule for L225, L350 and L367 on the original PR1094 k8 scalar word. The bounded domain is `[-4,4]^3` at each of 347 incident ADDs per orientation, split into 23 source-separated blocks. The seed-selected helpers share two distinct ADDs: L225/L367 at source event 19,531 and L225/L350 at event 22,786; L350/L367 do not share an ADD.

The exact three-coordinate optimizer saves 384 real / 768 complex primitives per orientation from the original word:

- Forward: 149,002 → 148,234 complex primitives.
- Backward: 149,018 → 148,250 complex primitives.

That is 294 complex primitives per orientation below PR1380’s exact L225/L350 pair schedule. Paid profile, prefix ceilings and depth bounds are unchanged. Both transformed words replay on all 712 formal columns; the three changed helpers are restored and all eight private centers clear.

This is a bounded scalar-circuit result on the original PR1094 word. The later PR1263 static word has a lower invoice. No global-optimality, physical-admission, supplier-adoption or new-kappa claim is made; the selected base kappa remains `836330098538459/500000000000000000`.

## Reproduction and validation

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/k8-three-coordinate-temporal-seed21/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/k8-three-coordinate-temporal-seed21/test_package.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-three-coordinate-temporal-seed21 --check-only
make selected-record-check
```

Expected verifier summary:

```text
PASS_K8_THREE_COORDINATE_TEMPORAL
forward incident_adds 347 blocks 23 real_delta -384 complex_delta -768 complex_primitives 148234 scales 71 all712=pass
backward incident_adds 347 blocks 23 real_delta -384 complex_delta -768 complex_primitives 148250 scales 76 all712=pass
shared_adds {'19531': [225, 367], '22786': [225, 350]} pair_control -474
```

The exact 3D distance transform and recurrence match dense small-domain controls. The verifier checks literal coefficient lowering, full invoices, frames, paid profiles and the 192-bit local charge; it also reconstructs PR1380’s pair schedule and matches its full-word hash and invoice. Missing-schedule, out-of-domain and wrong-sign controls reject. The direct replay, three focused tests, package metadata/source pins and selected-record check pass on CPython 3.14.7. Python 3.12 is unavailable locally, so the registered Python 3.12 package replay was not run.

## Provenance, overlap and limits

Exact base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. The PR1094/PR1042 source archives, PR696 lowerer, selected record, research status and ledger are pinned in `SOURCES.json`. PR1380 head `c2bc6848cffb2e2203095d4c4bbc45b0848c22e7` is the pairwise predecessor and positive control; PR1322’s common-shift triple result concerns a different schedule family.

The final overlap refresh found PR1388’s L348/L359 pair and PR1385’s L259 schedule on the later PR1263 word, plus active claims for L284 and L248/L253/L259 on that word. They use a different source word and coordinate set; exact heads and claim links are recorded in `TASK.json`.

The search exhausts the fixed 729-state box for this triple and stops there. It does not screen other triples or larger exponent boxes. Native/hosted admission and full selected cold replay remain unrun.

Prepared by Cinna Davis / @1337isnot1337 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in task selection, exact optimization, implementation, verification and writing. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
